prompt: Which combination would help both rooms stay warmer while preserving how each needs to be used?
promptZh: 哪一組措施既能幫助兩間房保暖，又能維持各自的使用需求？

options.text: Fit draft strips in both rooms.
options.whyZh: 音樂教室的窗戶一直關著，且氣流從窗框滲入，適合防風條；縫紉室工作時都會開窗，不符合使用條件。

options.text: Use a short thermal curtain in the sewing room and a draft strip in the music room.
options.zh: 縫紉室使用短版隔熱窗簾，音樂教室裝防風條。
options.whyZh: 縫紉室的工作人員願意開燈和拉簾，短簾下緣可停在暖氣上方；音樂教室的氣流來自持續關閉的窗框，防風條也不會擋住老師看庭院。

options.text: Use a thermal curtain in each room, choosing the short version for the sewing room.
options.zh: 兩間房都用隔熱窗簾，縫紉室選短版。
options.whyZh: 短簾符合縫紉室的暖氣位置；但窗簾須拉上才有效，會妨礙音樂教室的老師在上課時看庭院。

options.text: Use a standard thermal curtain in the sewing room and a draft strip in the music room.
options.zh: 縫紉室使用標準長度的隔熱窗簾，音樂教室裝防風條。
options.whyZh: 音樂教室的做法可行，但標準長度窗簾的下部會遮住縫紉室的暖氣，不符合窗簾下緣必須停在暖氣上方的限制。

explanationZh: 縫紉室的工作人員願意開燈和拉簾，短簾下緣可停在暖氣上方；音樂教室的氣流來自持續關閉的窗框，防風條也不會擋住老師看庭院。

vocabulary.note: 文中的防風條是針對會持續關閉的窗及窗框漏風，不適合固定要開的窗。

evidence: We are trying two removable measures this winter. A draft strip may be fitted only to a window that remains fully shut while the room is in use; it does not block ordinary drafts elsewhere in the room. A thermal curtain can be opened at any time, but its lower edge must stop above a wall heater. We have a short version for that purpose. Thick curtains do little for people who have to keep a room well lit during the day, because they work only when closed. / The sewing room is occupied in the afternoon. Staff open the window during every work session, but they are willing to use ceiling lights and close a curtain. The heater sits where the lower part of a standard curtain would hang. The music room is used at night; its window stays closed, and air comes in around the loose window frame. The teacher needs to see the courtyard from that room while teaching. These rooms have separate budgets, so a measure available for one is not taken away from the other.
